full_prompt_en: The image is a square black-and-white street photograph taken from a steep high angle, showing scattered pedestrians walking along a diagonal boundary and casting long shadows. The upper half is a broad pale gray surface with subtle texture and few details, darkening into a rougher patch at the upper right. A thin bright edge cuts from the left lower-middle toward the upper right, separating that pale expanse from a darker grainy paved area below. Small figures move along or just below this line at intervals rather than forming a dense crowd. At the left, a lone dark figure walks near the boundary, with an elongated shadow reaching almost straight down. Slightly to the right, another figure raises an arm near the head; its shadow falls in the same downward direction. Near the center, two overlapping walkers create a denser knot of dark coats, legs, and shadow shapes. Farther right, two more separate figures stride along the edge, and a partly cropped figure appears near the upper-right corner. The people are rendered mostly as black silhouettes, with only small pale gaps at arms and legs giving clues to their movement. Across the lower area, their shadows stretch several times their height toward the bottom edge, some merging briefly before separating again. A small rectangular object with a dark top sits alone in the lower-left portion, casting its own short shadow, while one tiny dark mark lies near the lower right. The light is hard and low from the upper side of the frame, making the narrow boundary glow and projecting the long, sharply directed shadows over the darker pavement. Fine film grain softens the continuous gray areas without weakening the black silhouettes. The distant viewpoint flattens the space into a simple diagonal division interrupted by rhythmic human marks. The overall composition uses pale and dark gray fields, one bright sloping line, and repeated long shadows to create a spare, graphic sense of urban motion.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形黑白街头摄影，从很高的角度俯视，拍到分散的行人沿一条斜向分界行走并投下长影。上半部是一片宽大的浅灰表面，纹理细微、细节很少，右上角逐渐变成较粗糙的暗斑。一道细亮边从左侧中下方切向右上，将浅色区域与下方更深、带颗粒的铺地分开。小人影隔着间距沿线或在线下行走，并未组成密集人群。左侧一个孤立深色人影靠近分界，细长投影几乎直伸向下。略往右，另一人抬起手臂靠近头部，其影也落向同一方向。中央附近两名行人互相遮挡，深色外套、腿与影子结成更密的一团。再往右，两名分开的身影沿边缘迈步，右上角附近还有一个被部分裁切的人。人物大多表现为黑色剪影，只有手臂和腿间的小浅缝提示动作。下部区域中，他们的投影朝底边伸展，长度约为身高的数倍，有些短暂合并又重新分开。下部左侧一件带深色顶面的长方物件独立放着，也投下一道较短影子；右下还有一个细小暗痕。强而低的光从画面上方一侧照来，使窄分界发亮，并把方向清楚的长影投过较暗地面。细胶片颗粒柔化连续的灰色区域，却没有削弱黑色剪影。远距离视点把空间压成被有节奏人影打断的简洁斜向分隔。整体构图以浅灰与深灰色域、一条明亮斜线和重复长影，形成简洁图形化的城市运动感。
style_prompt_en: High-angle black-and-white photography reduces a wide scene to a few pale and dark gray fields divided by a decisive diagonal. Small near-black silhouettes recur at uneven intervals, and their long directional shadows make a second rhythmic sequence across the lower area. Hard low light brightens the dividing edge while leaving the surrounding texture restrained. Fine grain and slight tonal variation remain visible inside otherwise simple expanses, keeping the geometry photographic rather than perfectly flat. The high viewpoint compresses depth and lets spacing, scale, and shadow length organize movement. Sparse isolated marks in the negative space prevent the pattern from becoming too regular. The overall effect is austere, graphic, and observant, with value contrast carrying nearly all the visual information.
style_prompt_zh: 高角度黑白摄影把宽阔场景压缩成由果断斜线分开的浅灰与深灰色域。近黑小剪影以不均匀间距重复，其长长的定向影子在下方又形成第二道节奏。低位硬光照亮分界边，周围纹理则保持克制。细颗粒与轻微调子变化仍留在看似简洁的大片区域里，使几何关系保持摄影感而非完全平涂。高视点压缩纵深，让间距、尺度和投影长度组织运动。负空间中稀疏的孤立小痕避免图案过于整齐。整体效果严峻、图形化而带观察感，几乎所有视觉信息都由明度反差承担。
theme_en: Pedestrians walking along a diagonal boundary and casting long shadows in a high-angle black-and-white view
theme_zh: 黑白俯视画面中，行人沿斜向分界行走，投下长影
name: Rene Burri
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
